group: Round 7 · Gear on the heroes: weapons in hand, armour worn
title: Armour worn 2: robes, cloaks, pelts and legends
use: Fixes the look of the armour worn on the heroes (game/js/entities/gear/armour.js), second half.
prompt: A costume sheet: the same blocky voxel hero, Percy Jackson (messy black hair, sea-green eyes), shown once per armour set in a row of figures at the same scale, each figure front-on with a small view from behind beside it (capes, quivers and wings show from behind), all in a neutral standing pose with the face clearly visible: helmets frame the face with cheek guards, hoods leave the face and the fringe showing. The armour is built from blocks over the hero's body: plates and pads on the chest, shoulders, forearms and shins, short strips or a robe hanging from the waist, capes from the shoulders. Flat light-grey background, no cast shadow. In this order: 1. Spartan Crimson Cloak: a crimson cape with bronze brooches and a crossed leather harness; 2. Nemean Lion Pelt: the golden lion's head worn as a hood (ears, brow and upper fangs over the forehead), the mane round the shoulders, the forepaws knotted on the chest, the pelt down the back; 3. Golden Fleece Mantle: a lumpy glowing gold wool mantle and a short fleece cape; 4. Armour of Achilles: a gold muscle cuirass with a gorgon face, lion-headed shoulder plates, gold greaves, a helmet with a tall white and blue plume and a royal blue cape; 5. Robe of Hebe: a peach chiton draped over one shoulder with a gold cord and a long robe; 6. Cloak of the West Wind: a pale sky-blue cape with white wind swirls and a feather clasp; 7. Winged Travelling Cloak: Hermes's low petasos hat with white wings, a short brown cloak and little wings at the ankles; 8. Lotus Hotel Bathrobe: a fluffy white bathrobe with a pink lotus and a sash; 9. Cloak of the Mist: a grey hooded cloak trailing pale wisps; 10. Wings of the Kindly Ones: a cape of leathery dark bat wings with bone fingers and a scalloped hem, a bone clasp on a harness; 11. Hellhound Hide: a black shaggy hide worn as a hood with hound ears, a snout and red glowing eyes, a fur mantle and cape; 12. Camp Half-Blood T-shirt: the hero's own orange camp shirt and jeans, for comparison. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
